issues.on_page: Property Taxes 253,121 + In Lieu of Tax 5% 38 (Budget and Actual - All Funds, Actual column)
issues.issue: The statement (p4) prints Property Taxes 253,159 as one line, but the p9 schedule breaks it into Property Taxes 253,121 and In Lieu of Tax 38 (253,121 + 38 = 253,159). Under the tax-line split rule, In Lieu of Tax 38 could be split out (split_from). Left unsplit; a person should decide.

This business-type cost-type line is the only one without function 'utilities', and its category is the function name 'utilities' rather than a cost type like the other lines (e.g. Utilities (power, gas, phone)). The same applies to detail[35] (Water 7,032) and detail[47] (Sewer 2,580).
